build_predator_prey_alley_hunt: build the predator_prey__alley_hunt substrate environment using the base_config.build function
create_default_config: create the default configuration for the predator_prey__alley_hunt substrate with 5 predators and 8 prey
create_ascii_maze_layout: create the ASCII map layout defining walls, corridors, spawn points, and apple locations for the alley hunt maze
create_char_prefab_mapping: create the character-to-prefab mapping dictionary that assigns game objects to ASCII characters in the maze
create_timestep_spec: create the timestep observation spec with RGB, STAMINA, and WORLD.RGB observation channels
